title: Ethernet Packet Processing
alt: A horizontal six-stage Ethernet packet pipeline with a separate management plane above, a shared rule table feeding the classifier and dashed configuration/policy links.
strengths: All six packet stages form a continuous left-to-right path with no gratuitous bends.
Rule lookup feeds Classifier directly while management policy feeds Scheduler separately.
Dashed copper control links and solid muted blue data links remain distinct, with readable short labels.
limitations: Generated in system_illustration mode with explicit flat-schematic art direction after exact guide variants omitted scope; not a certified netlist rendering.
The rule lookup is an abstract supplied-information relation; request and response handshakes are not expanded.
Final artwork is a raster engineering illustration and retains slight tonal variation.
